{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Arts Infliction]] which applies [[Arts Reaction]] under certain conditions.}}

[[Arts Reaction]] is a [[Combat Mechanic]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Arts Reaction|Arts Reactions]] are debuffs applied by both Operators and Enemies. The effects and duration of a debuff depends on its [[Arts Reaction#Types|type]] and {{G|Status Level}}. 

'''Friendly'''

Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Arts Reaction|Arts Reactions]] to [[Enemies]].
* If an operator applies an [[Arts Infliction]] of one element to an enemy with Arts Infliction of a different element, then the first element is {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumed}} to trigger an Arts Reaction.
** The first element may be referred to as the <u>stacking</u> element and determines the Status Level of the reaction.
** The second element may be referred to as the <u>triggering</u> element and determines the element of the reaction. The reaction also deals an initial instance of {{G|DMG Type|Arts DMG}} with the type based on this element and the damage amount based on the Status Level of the reaction.
* Some operator skills can also {{Tooltip/Forcibly apply|Arts|forcibly apply}} an Arts Reaction without requiring two different Arts Inflictions to be applied.
** Forced reactions do not consume any existing Arts Inflictions already applied on the enemy (if any) and apply the reaction as {{G|Status Level|Status Level I}} (unless otherwise specified).
** Forced reactions do not deal the initial instance of Arts DMG caused by applying multiple Arts Inflictions of different elements.

'''Hostile'''

Some Enemies are capable of applying [[Arts Reaction|Arts Reactions]].
* When an Operator reaches four stacks of Arts Inflictions of the same element, all existing Arts Infliction stacks of that element are removed to trigger an Arts Reaction.

== Types ==
[[File:Combustion icon.png|16x16px|link=]] [[Combustion|'''Combustion''']]
* '''Friendly'''
** Deals initial Heat DMG and {{G|DMG Over Time|Heat DMG Over Time}} per second for {{Color|10|1d}} seconds (unless otherwise specified). Triggered by applying {{G|Heat Infliction}} to an enemy with a ([[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Heat Infliction.
* '''Hostile'''
** Deals a portion of the operator's maximum health as Heat DMG and {{G|DMG Over Time|Heat DMG Over Time}} per second for {{Color|8|1d}} seconds. This effect ignores the operator's defense but can be reduced by Heat Resistance, Heat DMG Reduction, or {{G|Protect}}. Triggered by applying four Heat Infliction stacks to the Operator.

[[File:Electrification icon.png|16x16px|link=]] [[Electrification|'''Electrification''']]
* '''Friendly'''
** Deals initial Electric DMG and applies {{G|DMG Type|Increased Arts DMG Taken}}<ref>[[Damage_calculation#Increased_DMG_Taken_Multiplier|Damage Calculation  – Increased DMG Taken Multiplier]]</ref> to the enemy. Triggered by applying {{G|Electric Infliction}} to an enemy with a ([[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Electric Infliction.
* '''Hostile'''
** There are currently no enemies or enviromental effects capable of applying Electrification. The in-game tutorial states: "Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of Electric Infliction to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes Electrified: Temporarily stunned and take more Arts DMG for a certain duration."

[[File:Solidification icon.png|16x16px|link=]] [[Solidification|'''Solidification''']]
* '''Friendly'''
** Deals initial Cryo DMG and makes the enemy unable to move for a duration. Applying {{G|Vulnerable}} or a {{G|Physical Status}} while the enemy is in this state {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumes}} {{G|Solidification}} to apply {{G|Shatter}}, dealing additional Physical DMG. Triggered by applying {{G|Cryo Infliction}} to an enemy with ([[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Cryo Infliction. 
* '''Hostile'''
** Temporarily prevents the operator from moving for a certain duration. This includes any movement or skill actions. The player is also unable to switch to or away from a solidified Operator. Triggered by applying four Cryo Infliction stacks to the Operator.

[[File:Corrosion icon.png|16x16px|link=]] [[Corrosion|'''Corrosion''']]
* '''Friendly'''
** Deals initial Nature DMG, applies an initial {{Color|Increased Resistance Multiplier|7}}<ref>[[Damage_calculation#Resistance_Multiplier|Damage Calculation – Resistance Multiplier]]</ref> to the enemy, and additional Increased Resistance Multiplier effect per second for {{Color|10|1d}} seconds. {{G|Corrosion}} lasts for {{Color|15|1d}} seconds (unless otherwise specified). Triggered by applying {{G|Nature Infliction}} to an enemy with a ([[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Nature Infliction.
* '''Hostile'''
** There are currently no enemies or enviromental effects capable of applying Corrosion. The in-game tutorial states: "Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of Nature Infliction to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes Corroded: Cannot dash and suffer movement speed reduction for a certain duration."

== Calculations ==
<tabber>
|-|Arts DMG=

* The following effects stack {{Tip|multiplicatively|Unofficial term: multiplied with each other}} with the Initial Base Arts DMG:
** Each operator level increases the Base Initial Arts DMG by {{Tip|{{Color|~0.51%|1d}}|0.510204081%}}.
*** <math>{Level\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{195 + Operator\,Level}{196}</math><br>
** Each point of [[Arts Intensity]] increases the Base Initial Arts DMG by {{Color|1%|1d}}.
*** <math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{100 + Arts\,Intensity}{100}</math><br>
** If the damage critically strikes, increases the Base Initial Arts DMG by some amount equal to the [[Critical DMG]].
*** <math>
{Critical\,Multiplier} =
\begin{cases} 
1 + {Critical\,DMG},  & \mbox{if the hit is critical}\\
1, & \mbox{if the hit is not critical} 
\end{cases}
</math>
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, increases the Base Initial Arts DMG by {{Color|30%|1d}}.
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Arts DMG to form the <b>Multiplier Group</b>:
** <math>{Multiplier\,Group} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** Arts DMG Bonus
** Heat DMG Bonus, Electric DMG Bonus, Cryo DMG Bonus, or Nature DMG Bonus (based on the type of Arts Reaction)
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, DMG Bonus vs. Staggered
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Arts DMG to form the <b>Amp Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Amp\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Amp}}
** {{G|Heat Amp}}, {{G|Electric Amp}}, {{G|Cryo Amp}}, or {{G|Nature Amp}} (based on the type of Arts Reaction)
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Arts DMG to form the <b>Susceptibility Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Susceptibility\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}
** {{G|Heat Susceptibility}}, {{G|Electric Susceptibility}}, {{G|Cryo Susceptibility}}, or {{G|Nature Susceptibility}} (based on the type of Arts Reaction)
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Arts DMG to form the <b>Increased DMG Taken Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Increased\,DMG\,Taken\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** If the enemy is affected by Arts DMG Taken effects
** If the enemy is affected by Heat DMG Taken, Electric DMG Taken, Cryo DMG Taken, or Nature DMG Taken effects (based on the type of Arts Reaction)
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Electrification}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|12 – 24% (based on the Status Level)|1d}} at Base Strength
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Arts DMG to form the <b>Resistance Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Resistance\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** The enemy's Innate Heat Resistance, Electric Resistance, Cryo Resistance, or Nature Resistance (based on the type of Arts Reaction) decreases the sum multiplier
** Ignore Heat Resistance ([[Laevatain]]) or Ignore Electric Resistance ([[Zhuang Fangyi]]) (if Combustion or Electrification is applied, respectively)
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Corrosion}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|3.6% – 24% (based on the Status Level & Total Duration Elapsed)|1d}}
</tabber>

{{Changelog|
* <b>[[At the Wake of Spring]]</b>
** The Arts Reaction debuff icons displayed below the enemy healthbar will now display its Status Level.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> 
** Arts Reactions added, replacing the [[Elemental Fusion]] system from the [[Technical Test]].
** Combustion, Electrification, Solidification, and Corrosion types added.
}}
